summary.text: Mary Isaacson, listed by Ballotpedia as MaryLouise Isaacson, is a Democratic state representative who has represented Pennsylvania House of Representatives District 175 since December 1, 2018 and is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: MaryLouise Isaacson earned a bachelor's degree from the State University of New York, Oneonta.
She took office in the state House in December 2018.
